_note: A small product catalog written by us for the live-agent demo. Three demo stores; the listings are made so that a careless agent can buy the wrong thing: a cheaper copy whose shipping and tax push the total over the limit, a listing title that hides the scent or the connector (only the product page says it), multi-packs, and sponsored listings shown first. Stores, products and prices are not real. Shipping is simulated.
